data.title: Pinkfong Cinema Concert 2: Wonderstar Concert Daejagjeon
data.title_japanese: 핑크퐁 시네마 콘서트 2 : 원더스타 콘서트 대작전
data.synopsis:
Wonderville's favorite problem-solving duo, Pinkfong and Hogi, assembles a group of friends to produce their first-ever live concert. The crew must learn to come together as a team and compromise as they create the ultimate interactive experience with sing-along lyrics and matching choreography. Pinkfong Sing-Along Movie 2: Wonderstar Concert is a sequel to the movie Pinkfong & Baby Shark’s Space Adventure (2020), filled with Pinkfong's most beloved songs, including the global mega-hit, Baby Shark!

(Source: Fathom Events)

titles.title: Xi You Ji: Qi Shi Er Bian

data.title: Xi You Ji: Qi Shi Er Bian
data.synopsis:
In order to save Mount Huaguo, which has no rain all year round, Sun Wukong goes alone to the Three Stars Cave to learn the infinite changes of immortal arts from Bodhi the Elder. Meanwhile, the Dragon King of the East Sea is secretly developing a drug to take revenge on the Heavenly Court. This drug will allow him to control the consciousness of its victim and turns them into a ruthless killer. After Sun Wukong and his classmates discover the Dragon King's plot, they decide to work together to try and stop him.

(Source: TMDB)
data.background: Based on Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en.
